profile.headline: Ex-Amazon engineer & EdTech founder. I help Spanish-speaking autodidacts break into software with real training, community & clarity. Creator of academia-x.com & YouTube channel programadorX.com
profile.summary:
Solid front-end knowledge of HTML, CSS, Javascript, React, Angular, Vue.js, Typescript, and Redux.
Mobile front-end experience in React Native, Nativescript, Android Native and PWAs.
Strong understanding of design principles, UI/UX, Modular CSS, and responsive design.
Back-end expertise using Node.js/Express, Java/Spring, C#/.NET, Python/Django, Auth, Security and RESTful APIs.
AWS Certified and DevOps experience with CI/CD, Docker, AWS services, Kubernetes and microservice architectures.
Relational and nonrelational database administration using MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Firebase.
Positive attitude, strong work ethic, out-of-the-box thinking and high level of professional integrity.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer & Founder
positions.description:
Después de trabajar por varios años como Ingeniero de Software en varias empresas de tecnología en los Estados Unidos, decidí que era hora de iniciar mi propio emprendimiento. Empecé con videos de YouTube y en estos cursos comparto lo que he aprendido (sin guardarme nada) para ayudar a colegas de habla hispana a crecer en el campo de la tecnología.

Ahora utilizo mis habilidades tecnológicas y conocimientos comerciales para guiar y motivar a mis estudiantes a crear páginas web, aplicaciones, herramientas de automatización y aumentar sus posibilidades laborales en la industria tecnológica.

positions.title: Lead Sr. Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: Team Lead for a fleet management system designed for construction materials in 3 US regions with a fleet size of 60+ vehicles. Taught myself C#/.NET and  Java/Spring and developed ticketing, tracking, messaging, and management features with interlaced functionality. Fostered an environment of collaboration and productivity while setting strategies and mentoring experienced and junior teammates. (JS, HTML, CSS, React, ReactNative, C#/.NET, Java/Spring, PostgreSQL, Bluetooth, AWS, microservice architecture, scalability)

positions.title: Lead Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented features and designed the system for an enterprise legal services app to store, organize and filter trial evidence. Showcased Angular Drag and Drop work on a company public meetup and gave regular internal tech talks. (JS, HTML, CSS, Angular, Drag and Drop, PDF, OCR)
Mentor/Lead (company support role) for cross-team training, mentoring, performance reviews, interviews, and project hour estimates.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description: Developed interactive sites and infographics for small businesses and Fortune 500 companies. (JS, HTML, CSS, SVGs, D3.js, GSAP, JQuery, React, Firebase, Wordpress)

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Developed the Nintendo Disney Art Academy official website and other updates reaching Nintendo’s site audience for Enter the Studio LLC. (JS, HTML, CSS, JQuery, Gulp, responsive design, SEO, analytics, multi language support, and cross-browser compatibility for Wii and 3DS consoles)

Created and designed websites and apps for various clients. A stylist business website (HTML, CSS, JS, JQuery), a T-shirt ecommerce site (React, Stripe.js), a risk visualizer app (AngularJS), and a gaming app. (MongoDB, Angular, Node.js/Express, Phaser)

positions.title: GIS Specialist
positions.description: Retrieved, analyzed and processed XML, JSON, and KML data using Python providing worldwide support for Google Maps Engine. Created an in-house Javascript chrome extension for label creation and map styling. Automated 30K+ icon creation.

company.name: Randstad Staffing Services, Inc. at Google, Inc.
